case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost drivers so transparently. We take the movement in copper, labour and component costs seriously and have reviewed your figures carefully.

Having done so, we cannot accept the price as quoted. We have prepared three options, each balancing price against payment terms differently:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 339.74; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 329.81; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 337.49; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Each option is a complete, self-contained proposal, so any of them can go straight to your pricing committee. If your approval needs anything further from us, please let us know and we will provide it promptly.

We value working with Nordmark and look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for your prompt response and the structured options provided. While we appreciate your approach, the proposed prices are unfortunately far below our cost realities, especially given the substantial increases in copper and labour that we have outlined.

Our current offer stands at a price of €372.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative at our standard terms, we can offer a slight adjustment to a price of €370.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This represents our best effort to accommodate your request while maintaining a sustainable supply.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:

Thank you for your revised offer and for explaining your position so clearly. We understand that copper and labour weigh heavily on your costs, and we take your view of our earlier figures seriously.

We have moved towards you and set out three options:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 343.84; payment 60 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 333.79; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option C: unit price EUR 341.56; payment 30 days net; no index clause.

Option C reflects your interest in faster payment, settling at your standard terms. Each option is structured for straightforward review by your pricing committee, and we are glad to provide any further details your approval process requires.

We value working with Nordmark and look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your revised offer and your willingness to move closer to our position. However, the proposed prices remain insufficient to cover the verified increases in our raw material and labour costs. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our offer is a price of €372.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. As an alternative at standard terms, we can offer a further concession to €370.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel, which represents a significant step on our part.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
